description: The phone number a tax office, pension or benefits agency, immigration service, bank, student loan servicer or phone carrier publishes for people calling from OUTSIDE its country (domestic short codes, 0800/1-800 and 0300-style numbers mostly do not connect from abroad), as read on the organisation's own website, with its published hours and time zone, the source page, and a link that opens a browser dialer with the number filled in. Pass `organisation` ("HMRC", "Wells Fargo", "National Pension Service", "Kela") and optionally `country` to narrow it, or only `country` to list what is covered there. For how to dial a number use get_dialing_instructions; for what a call costs use get_call_price.

country.description: The organisation's country: an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code such as "MX", or an English name such as "Mexico".

organisation.description: The organisation, as people call it: "HMRC", "Social Security", "Banco BHD", "Kela".

name: find_number_for_callers_abroad
title: Number an organisation gives callers abroad
